name: Contrast-to-Noise Ratio (CNR)
aliases: Contrast-to-Noise Ratio (CNR) — CNR, FWHM, Quantitative Image Analysis Metrics, Smoothness
Quantitative quality metrics for volume rendering
definition: A metric evaluating how a denoiser strategy increases the contrast between a Region of Interest (ROI) and uniform background.
summary: Contrast-to-Noise Ratio measures the distinguishability of a feature from its background relative to noise, focusing on perceptual contrast rather than reconstruction robustness.
